notes.title: Pure Pool Pro | Dev Diary #6 – Closed Beta Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello again, cue sports fans! 👋
[/b][/p][p]We’ve got some exciting news to share: the [b]Pure Pool Pro Closed Beta kicks off on Wednesday, 24th September 2025[/b]. The Beta is planned to run for two weeks, giving a selected bunch of you a first look at the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/537bffea304bcd2bddd7549b04fd09a269c3f2c3.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Sign Up While You Can![/b][/h3][p]Sign-ups are still open through our [url="https://forms.gle/kepr8bp9LX4Y4jLe8"]Beta Sign Up Form[/url] - but spaces are limited. We’ll be contacting selected participants by email during the week beginning [b]15th September[/b]. Don’t forget: the Beta will be managed via a private Discord, so be sure to create an account in advance if you don’t already have one.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a966f9605e47e9b7d5c7de35f681994d90ff2c51.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]What’s in the Pure Pool Pro Closed Beta?[/b][/h3][p]To keep production well on track, we’ve had to shift the scope slightly since our earlier plan. This build still offers plenty to sink your teeth into:[/p][list][*][p][b]Freeplay in the Rackhaus[/b] – Rack up as many times as you like in the Rackhaus, our stylish new skyscraper venue. This is the place to spend plenty of time getting to grips with Pure Pool Pro’s physics and mechanics. Get comfortable and master each shot type in your arsenal. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Practice Matches[/b] – Face two lifelike AI opponents with contrasting difficulty: play Amber De Wit (Amateur) with full aim-line assistance, or take on Ethan Cruz (Focused) with limited aim-line support for a significantly tougher test. Each has their own distinctive play style. [/p][/*][*][p][b]A Brand-New Look[/b] – Soak in the atmosphere and admire the new visuals. New lighting with sharper reflections and detailed table surfaces, complete with baize fuzz! Note: please expect some unpolished visuals - or maybe the occasional lighting or reflection flicker - it’s still a work in progress! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Redesigned UI[/b] – A first look at our streamlined, modern interface. Again, your feedback will help us iron out the creases of some elements here. So expect the occasional bug - but this should give you a taste of how smooth we want the final experience to be.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/h3][p]We’re thrilled to finally let a bunch of you go hands-on with Pure Pool Pro. This Beta marks the beginning of an exciting run-up to launch!  

We'll be running another 'Ask the Devs' soon - so keep sharing your thoughts and questions about the beat below our posts.

  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456930/Pure_Pool_Pro/" style="button"]Wishlist Pure Pool Pro on Steam[/url][/p][p]See you at the table,
 – The Ripstone Team 🎱[/p]

notes.title: Pure Pool Pro | Ask the Devs #3
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey again, pool fans! 👋[/b]

Welcome to another round of [b]Ask the Devs[/b], where we respond to your questions about [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i] from across our social channels. 

With our [b]gameplay trailer[/b] now out in the wild and Beta sign-ups well underway, the conversation is heating up - so let’s dive into some of your most recent questions![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q1. [i]“Is there a chance of getting a beta for Xbox and PlayStation?”[/i][/h3][p]– @InsideXboxDE, X (formerly Twitter)[/p][p]Hey there – we hear you! The [b]Closed Beta is exclusive to Steam[/b]. We’re a very small team, and managing a multi-platform beta would stretch our resources to the point where it could impact the full launch timeline.

We chose Steam because it offers the smoothest pipeline for managing this kind of testing, but we really appreciate the interest from console players. Thank you for understanding – we'll do our best to make sure it’ll be worth the wait![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q2. [i]“Can you just shadow drop it lol I’m just that eager.”[/i][/h3][p]– Nathan, Facebook[/p][p]We love the enthusiasm, Nathan! Unfortunately, shadow dropping an unfinished game would be a terrible business plan haha! [b]Steam players can sign up for the Beta coming this September[/b] – it’s your best shot at getting hands-on early.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q3. [i]“Is there going to be a physical release? Also, will the ultimate pool rules be in place, or will there be a choice between old school rules and new ultimate pool rules?”[/i][/h3][p]– Tom A, Facebook[/p][p]Hi Tom! Right now, [b]we don’t have plans for a physical edition[/b], but we’d love to hear if there’s a demand for a limited run – let us know!

As for rulesets, that’s still being finalised. We’re considering both the classic and Ultimate Pool rules, and we're even consulting with a professional referee later in development to make sure we get it right.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q4. [i]“Looks great, is the Snooker pack at launch?”[/i][/h3][p]– MJ1931, Reddit[/p][p]Thanks so much! We're glad you’re excited. [b]The Snooker DLC won’t be available at launch[/b], but it is in our post-launch plans. Once the main game goes gold, we’ll be shifting focus straight to that![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q5. [i]“Will this game make its way to Nintendo Switch?”[/i][/h3][p]– Samarra, Steam Community[/p][p]Hi Samarra! Sadly, the performance demands of Pure Pool Pro exceed the specs of the original Switch, so we have no plans to bring it to that platform.

That said, [i]Pure Pool[/i] did eventually land on Switch, and we’ll always be open to revisiting platforms if the tech makes sense down the line.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q6. [i]“Will it play the same as Pure Pool? So the right thumb stick determines power, and no power bar. Only able to take shots head-on. And in multiplayer, allow us to see the opponent lining up a shot? Please say yes to all 3.”[/i][/h3][p]– Steve1977Beyond, Reddit[/p][p]Hey Steve — YES to all 3! [/p][list][*][p]You’ll still use the right thumbstick to determine shot power when playing with a controller[/p][/*][*][p]There’s no on-screen power bar – it’s still about feel and precision[/p][/*][*][p]And yes, you’ll see your opponent lining up their shots in real time[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re keeping the DNA of the original alive, with a fresh coat of polish.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q7. [i]“Will there be a top-down view?”[/i][/h3][p]– Horror-Abies-3403, Reddit[/p][p]Great question! [b]There won’t be a top-down view[/b] in [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i]. That’s a deliberate choice – just like in its predecessor, the goal here is immersion and realism.

You’ll be able to rotate around the table naturally between shots, but we avoid artificial broadcast-style angles so that all play decisions are made just like you were standing at the table in real life.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q8. [i]“Pretty awesome that this runs at native 8K! How did you guys even manage that? Some sort of culling, or is it because everything is just close up?”[/i][/h3][p]– @LivedWater, YouTube[/p][p]Thanks! It’s a mix of a few things. Pool’s fixed perspective helps – we’re always focused on a relatively small scene. But the real magic is our custom-built Magma Engine, which was purpose-built for cue sports. It lets us scale to extreme detail while keeping performance strong on high-end systems.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Q9. [i]“Release Date?”[/i][/h3][p]– @grashalm, Instagram[/p][p]We’re keeping this under wraps for now! 😉
The only thing we’ve said publicly is: [b]2025[/b]. As soon as we’re ready to share more, you’ll be among the first to know.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]💬 Got More Questions?[/h2][p]Didn’t see your question answered this time? Don’t worry – we’ll be back with another [b]Ask the Devs[/b] soon. In the meantime:[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6aXyjAT5pvs"]🎥 Watch the New Gameplay Trailer[/url]
🎮 [url="https://forms.gle/iUfEc1VVVeea3YK48"]Sign Up for the Closed Beta[/url]
[/p][p]Thank you for your support – every question, wishlist, and kind comment makes a difference![/p][p]– The Ripstone Team 🎱[/p]

notes.title: Pure Pool Pro | Dev Diary #5 – First Gameplay Trailer Revealed!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello again, cue sports fans! 👋[/b]

Just in case you've missed it - this week has marked a major milestone for [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i] - we’ve just dropped our [b]first official gameplay trailer[/b], giving you your first real look at the game in motion.
[/p][p]Captured entirely [b]in-engine on a pre-alpha PC build[/b], this trailer represents the first glimpse of what we’ve been working on since announcing the game back in April. You can watch the full trailer below – and yes, it really [b]was captured at native 8K resolution[/b].
[/p][previewyoutube="6aXyjAT5pvs;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]What You’re Seeing[/b][/h2][p]Save for the intro and outro logos, this trailer was captured entirely [b]in-engine[/b] on an early PC build. This is all pre-optimisation and running at [b]native 8K 30FPS[/b]. We’re still working hard to hit our targets of [b]8K 60FPS[/b] and [b]4K 120FPS[/b] by launch.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a966f9605e47e9b7d5c7de35f681994d90ff2c51.png"][/img]The entire sequence is set in [b]Rackhaus[/b], Pure Pool Pro's venue inspired by the intimate jazz bar in the original game and designed to highlight the lighting, reflections, and surface fidelity of our proprietary Magma Engine. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/6b9e904312b4b7eb932c2d372962a3396c0731a0.png"][/img][/p][p]Eagle-eyed viewers may have also noticed - that’s not just any old 2D tablecloth texture…that’s [b]baize with realistic fuzz and pilling[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Creator Reactions Rolling In![/b][/h2][p]We're excited to see creators, players, and press starting to react - and [b]Snooker YouTuber CaptainGoodspeed[/b] has already done a fantastic breakdown of the trailer.
[/p][previewyoutube="t0G16PslSa8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]His coverage dives deeper into what we’ve shown so far, and shares his thoughts on the future of Pure Pool Pro.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]New Giveaway Launched![/b][/h2][p]To further celebrate the trailer’s release, we’ve also kicked off a [b]brand-new Gleam giveaway[/b]. You could win a:[/p][p]🎮 [b]DualSense Edge Controller[/b] (PS5) or an
🎮 [b]Xbox Elite Series 2 Controller
[/b] ...along with a [b]free copy of Pure Pool Pro at launch![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/7348b539f60ab40ea8e57887b9d5f8de9f2f93ec.gif"][/img][b]
[/b]Pssst! There are also 5x Copies of Pure Pool Pro up for grabs for runners-up!
[/p][p][url="https://gleam.io/OL1uE/win-a-dualsense-edge-or-xbox-elite-controller-with-pure-pool-pro" style="button"]Enter the Giveaway Now[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Ask the Devs #3 – Coming Next Week![/b][/h2][p]We’re gathering up more of your burning questions about Pure Pool Pro – and we’ll be answering them in the next instalment of [b]Ask the Devs[/b], arriving next week.[/p][p]If you haven’t already, post your questions in our Steam Community thread or on our Discord![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Thank You for Supporting Pure Pool Pro[/b][/h2][p]Your support continues to blow us away. We’re thrilled by the reaction to the trailer so far – and we’re only just getting started.[/p][p]Keep wishlisting, sharing, and spreading the word. We can’t wait to show you more over the coming weeks and months.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456930/Pure_Pool_Pro/" style="button"]Wishlist on Steam[/url]
 [/p][p]See you at the table.
 – The Ripstone Team 🎱[/p]

notes.title: Pure Pool Pro | Ask the Devs #2
notes.notes:
[h2][b]❓ Ask the Devs – Community Q&A[/b][/h2][p]We’re back with another Ask the Devs! You’ve been sending in your questions across our social channels for the past few weeks, and we’ve picked out a bunch to answer right here...
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q1. “Will [i]Pure Pool Pro [/i]have controller support? Too many new Pool and Snooker games want me to use a mouse.”
[/b] – IBiLLyI72I?[i], Twitter[/i][/p][p][i]Pure Pool Pro[/i] will be fully optimised for both gamepad and mouse and keyboard play. We’re focused on making it feel intuitive, no matter what your preferences are. Within the studio itself, there’s a fairly even split of gamepad players and mouse and keyboard players. We’ll also be making sure that the upcoming Closed Beta is played by users of both control schemes. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q2. “So...we’re not getting a Beta on PS5 Pro?”
[/b] – [i]Bucci35, Twitter[/i][/p][p]Hey Bucci35...and to other console Pool Fans! The Closed Beta will be Steam only - We know this will be disappointing! [/p][p]We wanted to share a little bit more about our thinking behind this. As a small studio, running a multi-platform beta would massively stretch our resources to the point that it would likely delay the launch. We’ve chosen Steam as we identified it as the platform that would have the least impact on our current development timelines. This way, we can get the full game into your hands as soon as possible. Thanks for your understanding![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q3. “When playing with a controller, are shots still taken by using the thumbstick, like in the original [i]Pure Pool[/i]?”
[/b] – [i]Rhys, Facebook[/i][/p][p]Hey Rhys! Yes, [i]Pure Pool Pro [/i]will use a similar control scheme to the original, giving you the ability to tweak spin, finely adjust your aim before pulling back the thumb stick to precisely add power to your shot. Hope this helps![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q4. “Any idea when the game will be released? Can’t wait!”
[/b] – [i]Ieuan, Facebook[/i][/p][p]Hey Ieuan! We’re working hard to bring Pure Pool Pro to you as soon as it's ready. While we’re not locking in a specific release date yet, it will be arriving later in 2025.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q5. “Are Y'ALL adding any mechanics that weren't in the first game by chance?”
[/b] – [i]HOLO-FLASH, Reddit[/i][/p][p]Great question! At its core, [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i] keeps the mechanics you loved from the original intact - precise aiming, spin control, and shot power all return, refined but familiar. That said, we’ve introduced a few new touches to enhance immersion and player expression.[/p][p]One of the subtle but satisfying additions we’re making is the ability to choose your chalk colour. It’s a small detail, but it adds to the visual customisation of your cue, and we hope it makes your shots feel more personal.[/p][p]It’s a tricky one - we’re keeping the experience ‘Pure’ and grounded in realism, so while it’s not packed with over-the-top new mechanics or shot power-ups, every improvement is aimed at making the game more authentic, responsive, and stylish.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q6. “When will we see a gameplay trailer?”
[/b] – [i]@TiestoMagic6279, YouTube[/i][/p][p]Soon![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Keep the Questions Coming![/h3][p]If we missed your question - drop it below and we'll catch it next time around! 
[/p][p]Thanks again for all your support, and don’t forget to [url="http://loom.ly/H9B2gXo"]wishlist Pure Pool Pro[/url] if you haven’t already. It helps more than you can imagine. 🙏


 – The Ripstone Team[/p]

notes.title: Pure Pool Pro | Dev Diary #4 – What to Expect in the Closed Beta
notes.notes:
[p][b]🎱  Hello again, Pool fans! 👋
[/b][/p][p]We’re back with another Dev Diary - and this time we’re formally inviting you to be part of the future of [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i].
[/p][p]ICYMI: last week we announced a[b] Closed Beta[/b], coming to Steam later this year. This Beta will give a limited number of players their first hands-on look at the game, and we’re counting on your feedback to help us shape the final release.

[url="https://forms.gle/qW88QZT9Ncwz8HYd7" style="button"]👉 Sign Up Here 👈[/url]
[/p][p]In this diary, we wanted to give you a full rundown of what to expect from the Beta build, what’s included, and how to get involved.

Let’s dive in![/p][p][/p][h2][b]What is the Pure Pool Pro Closed Beta?[/b][/h2][p]The Closed Beta is a limited test aimed at giving players a taste of [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i] while also helping us gather early feedback on gameplay, visuals, and systems.
[/p][p]We’re keeping things focused. This isn’t a full demo or preview of everything the final game has to offer. However, it should give you a real sense of where we’re headed

We’re eager to get as many of you involved, but spaces will be limited! At this stage, we need to test on all manner of system specs - so even if you're running a rig at the lowest end of our estimated system requirements, be sure to sign up. 
[/p][p]Simply put, if you’re interested in trying [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i] early, now’s the time to raise your hand. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]What We’re Planning to Include in the Beta[/b][/h2][p]Here’s a breakdown of what we plan to make available in the Beta build when it goes live later this year:[/p][h3]Game Rules/Modes[/h3][list][*][p][i]8-Ball rules only[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Free Table Mode for casual solo play and practice[/p][/*][/list][h3]Venues[/h3][p]The [b]Tetradome[/b], our futuristic 1,000-seat competitive arena, will be the only playable environment in the Beta. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a040930e7c85b465871d4e0add9c9ad6e110181b.png"][/img]The recently revealed[b] Rackhaus[/b][i] [/i]venue, however, is being held back. We want to keep some surprises for the full launch!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a80fdeb4a201e9a4265e5952f4ad3e25d9c7143f.png"][/img][/p][h3]Career Preview[/h3][p]Beta Players will be able to access [b]Tour 1: Barroom Breakers[/b] – an early slice of our new Career Mode. This will feature a handful of meaningful events with some progression.

[/p][h3]Visual Fidelity[/h3][p]The beta build will give you a clear glimpse of the game’s graphical goals - but it’s important to note that this will be a work in progress. Beta players should expect to see some glitches and visual hiccups, and be sure to report them to us when they do!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a7e2ba769131953a3dd821a43dfbbfda6a77a792.png"][/img]
Things such as native 8K, high-end lighting, and refined reflections should be present by Beta, but they will not be entirely optimised at this stage. If your setup is highly capable, don’t be alarmed if it struggles to run things at buttery smooth framerates (again - report performance hiccups when you can).  [/p][h3]Customisation[/h3][p]Naturally, we’ll be locking off most of our unlockable cues, balls, and baizes - but you will be able to preview them in our Equipment menu!
 [/p][h3]Calls to Action[/h3][p]Wishlisting and feedback reminders will be integrated into the Beta experience.[/p][h3]
Controls[b] [/b][/h3][p]Both Gamepad and Mouse & Keyboard support will be available.
[/p][h2][b]What’s Not Included?[/b][/h2][p]To ensure clarity, here’s what won’t be part of the Closed Beta build:[/p][p]❌ No Online Multiplayer
❌ No additional game types (e.g. 9-Ball, Blackball, Killer)
❌ No access to the [b]Rackhaus[/b] venue
❌ Limited career mode and customisation 
[/p][h2][b]How to Sign Up[/b][/h2][p]Interested in joining the Closed Beta this September?[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/qW88QZT9Ncwz8HYd7" style="button"]👉 Sign Up Here 👈[/url]
[/p][p]Spaces will be limited, so get signed up now! We’ll be reviewing every submission and reaching out to selected players closer to the Beta period.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Help Us Spread the Word
[/b][/h2][p]We’re incredibly proud of how [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i] is shaping up, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon - including our upcoming [b]gameplay trailer[/b] (watch this space 👀). 

Just last week, you helped us surpass 5,000 wishlists - our first significant milestone on the road to launch. Now we're calling on you for more support! 
   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/8edd4132e4649bba05ca08965793e2b20edcba72.gif"][/img]

If you haven't already, please consider [url="loom.ly/H9B2gXo"]wishlisting the game,[/url] and please feel free to share the Beta sign-up with friends, fellow creators, and anyone who loves the sound of a modern cue sports sim.
[/p][p]Thanks again for all your support - and we’ll see you at the table very soon.[/p][p]– The Ripstone Team 🎱[/p]

notes.title: Pure Pool Pro | Dev Diary #3 – Welcome to the Rackhaus
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello again, Pool fans! 👋[/b]

We’re back with another peek behind the curtain at the development of [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i]. This time, we’re introducing a brand-new venue that we’ve been super eager to show you. We’re also answering a bunch of the excellent ‘Ask the Devs’ questions you've sent in!

Quick update before we dive in: We’re making great progress on rendering and UI - this is the stage where our visuals start to come to life. 

This work lays the foundation for a stable, in-engine gameplay reveal trailer, which we’re excited to share with you very soon.
[/p][p]Thanks for your continued patience. Now, onto the reveal!  [/p][h2][b]Introducing the Rackhaus[/b][/h2][p]
When designing [i]Pure Pool Pro[/i], we knew we wanted to balance the high-stakes tension of our futuristic [b]Tetradome[/b] arena with something a little more…inviting.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a80fdeb4a201e9a4265e5952f4ad3e25d9c7143f.png"][/img]Enter the [b]Rackhaus[/b] - a stylish, cosy pool hall nestled at the top of a luxury skyscraper, designed for more intimate matches, invitation-only career mode events, and relaxing sessions with friends.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/6a99d8824fe52540669244c408c7eb023d9246c0.png"][/img][/p][p]This space was created as a spiritual successor to the[b] Jazz Club[/b] from the original [i]Pure Pool[/i], a fan favourite for its ambient vibe and chill soundtrack.   
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/bbb2f6a9499757c8b7df4ec325ade620098506a4.png"][/img]The Rackhaus takes that concept to the next level, with rich visual detail, warm lighting, and moody panoramic views of a rainy night’s sky.    

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/27bc7372781d7c0b6345378753bc28daaaa1b44b.png"][/img][/p][p]Fans will be glad to know there will also be a bespoke easy-listening music playlist for this venue to truly enhance those vibes. You’ll find yourself racking up frames under warm lighting, in a setting that feels as good for high-concentration tour matches as it does for unwinding after a long day.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/d53cb97af398413686169b864331fdea4a160fea.png"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this first glimpse at the Rackhaus atmosphere![/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Ask the Devs – Community Q&A[/b][/h2][p]You’ve been sending in your questions across our social channels, and we’ve picked a batch to answer right here in our very first [b]“Ask the Devs”[/b] section. Let’s dive in:
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q1. “Is the resolution you’re targeting going to be native or dynamic? Is path tracing achievable?”
[/b] – [i]Bucci35, Twitter[/i][/p][p]We’re targeting native resolution wherever possible - including support for native 8K on high-end PCs and PS5 Pro. We’re not using path tracing currently, but we are utilising advanced lighting and physically accurate reflections to get as close to that level of realism as possible. We are investigating the viability of adding path tracing at a later date, but it won't be available at launch.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q2. “When will there be more news or gameplay footage?”
[/b] – [i]Muzie, Discord[/i][/p][p]You’re in luck - our full Gameplay Reveal Trailer isn't too far away. This will showcase what the game looks and feels like in motion, with all footage captured in-engine at native 8K. Look out for more news in the coming weeks![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q3. “Any chance you’ll add more game types like 10-ball, straight pool or banks?”
[/b] – [i]Holo-Flash, Reddit[/i][/p][p]At launch, we’re focusing on 8-ball, 9-ball, Blackball, Killer and challenge modes like Speed Pot and Royal Rumble. But we're absolutely listening to requests like this. Snooker is coming as a post-launch DLC, and we are looking at additional modes. We never say never - if there’s enough appetite for them, we’ll consider it![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q4. “Will the game feature controller support on PC? That would be amazing!”
[/b] – [i]its_kevin11, Reddit[/i][/p][p]Absolutely. Controllers are supported in Pure Pool Pro on PC, with smooth, precise input for every shot. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q5. “How will the actual shot-taking system work?”
[/b] – [i]sakurajima1981, Reddit[/i][/p][p]A lot of our feedback encouraged us to keep the core elements of the aiming and shot-taking system from the original Pure Pool. You’ll once again be given the ability to add spin, control shot strength, and tweak things precisely to allow you to execute almost any kind of complex shot you can dream up (once you master it, that is!). The gameplay reveal will show how it works in action![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q6. “Will I be able to move the camera around while the CPU takes its shot? Or after I shoot?”
[/b] – [i]Elvira4Ever, Reddit[/i][/p][p]Hi Elvira4Ever - at launch, you’ll only be able to circle the table before taking your shots to help you set up your next play or soak in the detail of the venue. This is an interesting idea, though! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q7. “When is the release date?”
[/b] – [i]@CSGNetwork, Twitter[/i][/p][p]While we’re not ready to reveal anything other than ‘2025’ at this stage, there will be an exciting opportunity to get your hands on it ahead of launch…more on that in the coming weeks![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q8. “Compared to Pure Pool, what will this new Pro version contain that wasn’t in the original?”
[/b] – [i]Nick Mahlitz, Facebook[/i][/p][p]Pure Pool Pro is a true sequel, not a remaster or repackage. While the core gameplay you loved from the first game remains intact, everything else has been either rebuilt or refined. Expect brand-new visuals with native 8K support, smarter AI opponents, a polished Career Mode, stunning new environments, and a fresh Daily Clearance challenge. Online play has also been overhauled with seamless cross-play, the UI has been completely modernised, and an enhanced Accolades & Crests system now lets you showcase your skills directly on your Player Card! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q9. “Will there be cross-platform gaming?”
[/b] – [i]Andrew Marmon, Facebook[/i][/p][p]Yes! Pure Pool Pro features improved netcode and full cross-platform multiplayer between Steam, Epic, PS5, and Xbox Series. We’re building a much more robust backend for smoother play.[/p][h3]

Last Week to Enter our Gleam Competition!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/8d7a6c970b0f8e5fa6ecc7ecd04d68e032cf4fac.png"][/img][/h3][p]Enter via the link below for a chance to win either an RTX 5070 or a PS5 Pro. Hurry! Competition ends 20.06.25 - with our winners being announced the following Monday.

[url="https://loom.ly/Voxfyd4" style="button" buttoncolor="#1e2023"]Enter the Pure Pool Pro Competition![/url]
[/p][h3]Keep the Questions Coming![/h3][p]If we didn’t catch your question this time round, don’t worry! We’ll be answering more questions in the next diary - so if there’s something you’re desperate to know, let us know again via our Socials![/p][p]Thanks again for all your support, and don’t forget to [b]wishlist Pure Pool Pro[/b] if you haven’t already. It helps more than you can imagine. 🙏

 – The Ripstone Team 🎱[/p]

notes.title: Pure Pool Pro | Dev Diary #2 – Features Overview
notes.notes:
[b]👋 Hello again, Pool fans![/b]

Welcome to Pure Pool Pro’s second Dev Diary. This week, we’re lifting the lid on some of the key features that set Pure Pool Pro apart; including its new modes, some of its technical improvements, and a first look at our all-new UI.

Before we dive in, a huge thank you for your patience and enthusiasm as we head toward our first gameplay reveal.

Production is currently focused on rendering and UI, with our team working hard to optimise both visuals and gameplay ahead of the full reveal in the coming months!

As always, we’re keen to hear your thoughts, so drop us your questions in the comments and we’ll answer them in future diaries.

[h2]What's New in Pure Pool Pro?[/h2]
A lot of you have been eager for more details on what makes this a true and worthy sequel to Pure Pool. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a7e2ba769131953a3dd821a43dfbbfda6a77a792.png[/img]

While Pure Pool Pro builds on the solid foundations of the first game, it’s much more than just a visual upgrade. Here’s a high-level overview of some of the things coming your way:

[h3]Overhauled Opponent AI[/h3]
We’ve reworked AI opponents from the ground up to feel more human and challenging at every level using adaptive logic to simulate realistic shot selection and pressure play. A lot of your feedback on the first Pure Pool expressed that some opponents could feel like infallible pool-playing robots! This time round we want you to expect varied personalities, risky plays, and intense high-stakes matches. Expect the odd mistake, too; even Pure Pool Pros fluff their lines sometimes.

[h3]All-New UI & Presentation[/h3]
Another key point of criticism from the first game was that its UI wasn’t up to the same visual standard of the gameplay.

For the sequel, we’re making navigating menus, career, online lobbies and customisation, stylish, and much more modern.

Our goal? To give Pool a slicker user experience, putting it on par with other industry-leading sports games.

👇 Here’s an exclusive pre-alpha look at our redesigned Career UI:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/9b3cdd1ab4739cacc100396265d7572d03d0ce6b.png[/img]

The 'Hustler's Hangout' event features early on in our 8-Ball career. In it, you'll face off against a handful of Amateur opponents and test your skills in Challenge modes such as Perfect Potter, Speed Pot, and Checkpoint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/c2ced8c6789143c3201a4f8d0179831dd270687f.png[/img]

[h3]Deeper Career Mode[/h3]
A big focus for us! This time round, Pure Pool Pro features a full single-player Career with over 25 AI opponents spanning multiple pool disciplines:

[list]
[*] 8-Ball
[*] 9-Ball
[*] Blackball
[/list]

Each career has its own progression path and structure, with branching difficulty tiers, unique opponents and varied challenges.

[h3]Seamless Cross-Platform Online Play[/h3]
In Pure Pool Pro, you’ll be able to play against friends across all supported platforms including Steam, Epic, PlayStation 5 (incl. PS5 Pro), and Xbox Series X|S - with streamlined ‘friend code’ matchmaking.

Pure Pool Pro ‘DNA’ profiles will also be returning from the first game. For those unaware, a DNA profile will be built as you play creating an accurate AI interpretation of yourself, your friends and your foes’ playstyles - which you can still play against, even when they’re not online.

[h3]Two New Venues[/h3]
The game will feature two dynamic playing environments at launch, both of which will subtly change things like advertising boards, and lighting depending on the event.

[b]The TetraDome Arena[/b] 
This is the 1,000 seat venue seen in the first screenshots we've released. This is a big departure from the cozy jazz club found in the original Pure Pool - but we think players will really enjoy the heightened atmosphere for competitive play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a040930e7c85b465871d4e0add9c9ad6e110181b.png[/img]

[b]‘The Penthouse’[/b]
A more intimate, stylish space for those craving classic Pure Pool vibes. We haven't revealed this one just yet; or even named it! We're calling it the 'Penthouse’ in production. It's a modern, cozy, open plan apartment at the top of a skyscraper. In vibe, this one has been designed to feel a lot more like the Pure Pool jazz club. We had a lot of feedback from players saying they enjoyed that venue's relaxing vibe - so we've made sure to include something similar!

[h2]Let Us Know What You Think![/h2]
We’ll be diving deeper into specific features - including online play, personalisation, and our work on physics - in the diaries.

In the meantime, if you’ve got a burning question or feedback on what you’ve seen so far, hit the comments below or join us over in the [url=https://discord.gg/ripstone]Discord[/url].

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456930?utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=CrossPromotion&snr=2___]Oh, and don’t forget to wishlist Pure Pool Pro![/url][/h2]

It helps us massively - and ensures you won’t miss a beat as we get closer to launch.


Thanks again for all your support so far!
 – The Ripstone Team 🎱

notes.title: Pure Pool Pro | Dev Diary #1 - A Closer Look at the Reveal
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Pool fans![/b]

Welcome to the first of our Pure Pool Pro Dev Diaries. 

Over the coming months, we’ll be jumping in here to share behind-the-scenes insights into the development of the game - starting today with a closer look at the announcement screenshots.

We'll also be using this diary to answer any of your burning questions along the way - so be sure to add them in the comments! 

Read on for thoughts from our Ripstone art team on why these shots were chosen and what they reveal about the technology and artistry driving Pure Pool Pro.

[h2]🔎 Analysing the Announcement Screenshots[/h2]

[h3]Screenshot 1: Cue Tip Impact[/h3]
This close-up also became the game's key art! We feel it showcases the incredible level of detail we're pushing for in Pure Pool Pro. When a cue strikes, you’ll notice minute chalk dust particles dispersing - a result of our Magma Engine's real-time particle effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/27ac0ae7f8c1b7292c0a85de12d65b578fd35217.png[/img]

Looking closer, you'll notice our ball surfaces aren't just glossy and super reflective. They're textured with micro-imperfections, clear coat scratches, and subtle colour bleed - simulating the real-world wear, dirt, and lacquer imperfections seen on professional equipment. In the game, this will be rendered at native 8K fidelity.

Fun fact: for images, Steam's upload filesize limit is just 5MB! So we're hosting the 8K screenshots, [url=ripstone.com/pure-pool-pro]here[/url]. We recommend pulling them up on your biggest and best display and zooming in on the details.

[h3]Screenshot 2: Break[/h3]
This action shot highlights not just movement but also material accuracy. Each ball features real-world manufacturing effects, including clear coat lacquer, colour variation, and minute flaws. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a7e2ba769131953a3dd821a43dfbbfda6a77a792.png[/img]

Even the baize (table cloth) has been custom simulated with displaced cloth techniques, individual fluff strands, and nap distortion to enhance that hyper-realism!

[h3]Screenshot 3: Motion & Atmosphere[/h3]
Here, speed and atmosphere collide. We know players have mix feelings about motion blur - but we us it dynamically to capture the pure force of each shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/f8d2435d1e36192c70acd6ab3b1c8bd1f5652093.png[/img]

In the background, the Pure Pool Pro Arena recreates the feel of a real-world competitive venue - crowds, moving branding, LED boards, and camera rigs. In the full game, the branding and themes will even change depending on the event you’re playing, bringing variety and atmosphere to every match.

[h3]Screenshot 4: Surface Detail[/h3]
On close inspection, you’ll see not just reflections but also fine imperfections — dirt, wear, scuffs, and clear coat flaws, all behaving accurately under dynamic lighting. Our physically-based rendering ensures every ball and surface reacts just like real materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a81e906572088db08a3dfb424182f7e2d4e572f6.png[/img]

[h3]Screenshot 5: The TetraDome - Our New Pantheon of Pool![/h3]

We couldn't reveal the game without giving you a glimpse of your stage for the next generation of pool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a040930e7c85b465871d4e0add9c9ad6e110181b.png[/img]

The TetraDome is a fully dynamic tournament arena, inspired by real-world pro events. A 1000-strong crowd, broadcast cameras and atmospheric lighting all combine to create the complete professional sports experience.

[h3]💭 Final Thoughts[/h3]
We hope this gave you a deeper dive into the work going into Pure Pool Pro! 

As always, we’re keen to hear your thoughts and questions - drop them below or join us on [url=discord.gg/ripstone][Discord][/url] where the team regularly chats with the community.

And if you haven’t already:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456930?utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=CrossPromotion&snr=2___]👉 Don’t forget to wishlist Pure Pool Pro to stay updated![/url]

👉  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456930?utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=CrossPromotion]WISHLIST LINK[/url]

[previewyoutube=aU6Jb9rEbkU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is Pure Pool Pro?[/h2]
Pure Pool Pro is the sequel to 2014's Pure Pool. Our most ambitious cue-sports game to date. We've taken everything we learned from Pure Pool and pushed it even further - from visual fidelity to gameplay depth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/27ac0ae7f8c1b7292c0a85de12d65b578fd35217.png[/img]

Featuring native 8K visuals (yes, really), cutting-edge lighting, and physically detailed surfaces, the game aims to look and feel as close to real pool as possible - whether you're lining up the break or potting a nerve-wracking black in a packed arena.

🎯 Career Mode is deeper, AI opponents are smarter and more reactive, and the entire experience is wrapped inside the TetraDome — our new futuristic, high-stakes venue built for the best of the best.

[list]

[*] Live real-time multiplayer (replacing the old asynchronous system from Pure Pool)
[*] Multiple pool rule sets (8-Ball, 9-Ball, Blackball, Killer...)
[*] A brand new progression system with unlockable cues, tables, balls, and more
[*] Seamless new UI built for modern platforms
[*] Local multiplayer! 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586874/a81e906572088db08a3dfb424182f7e2d4e572f6.png[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

We're gearing up to release Pure Pool Pro in 2025. In the coming months we'll debut gameplay, and begin to dig into the details of the sequel.
